support_dependency_details.purpose:
Template-derived yield estimation and a plain continuation controller.

The exact nano-graphrag source is vendored with its MIT license and SHA-256.
The completed real-score quasi-likelihood adapter comes from the supplied
orbital template. Raw credit marks are fitted against measured progress-receipt
times. Signed corrections use paired gain/loss marks at the SAME real times:
positive=max(delta,0), loss=max(-delta,0). No raw observation is replaced,
removed, smoothed, or appended twice. Each mark fits the full observed history.

Gain/loss model bands use Bonferroni alpha/2 and interval subtraction. This is
an approximate, uncalibrated working-model interval; Bonferroni allocation does
not make the source Laplace approximation coverage calibrated. Before any loss
has been observed, only the nonnegative time-conditioned model is used.
The no-loss working model assumes zero loss until a correction is observed.
After a loss, both marked fits are retained for every later full-history fit.

The controller receives one cumulative score per completed local action and
passes its raw signed difference to the estimator. Its only numerical stop rule
is available upper bound <= configured cost. It has no memory, smoothing,
consecutive-zero rule, action cap, source-completion test, or scientific gate.

NATIVE_EVENT_GUIDANCE.literal: The separate native_event_targets input names native notification targets assigned or actually received by this episode. Its state_changed event means the original service exit receipt was committed; the service may still be closing, so this does not establish result readiness or a child episode return. after_cursor records an event cursor actually received, initially zero. REPAIR_GUIDANCE.literal: When pending_child_delivery is supplied, the selected child has finished its work but its typed return has not been delivered. REPORT_GUIDANCE.literal:
A commissioned child returns ONLY the parent's typed form. Fill report_update
inside this existing reasoning response. It describes your actual interpretation
of the supplied state BEFORE the selected next action. The result of a later tool
has not thereby been interpreted. At yielding, recorded fact fields describe
actual work, while interpretive fields retain their latest actual basis; prefer
actual assessment/annotation references where those express the requested meaning.
requested_report_purpose is the parent's actual information need. current_report_update
contains the latest admitted interpretation fields, initially the parent's supplied
initial values. Those initial values are not a new child judgment. Preserve their
declared meanings when revising the form; neither input chooses your scientific action.
As parent, request source-bound outcome and basis fields when needed to distinguish
new observations from prior interpretations. There is no separate report composer.
A report_delivery_failure is operational feedback about an already completed
child. You can select redeliver_report with a revised closed contract, using the
delivery_ref shown in report_deliveries or report_delivery_failure. It reuses
saved facts and exactly the child's existing interpretation fields; it performs
no new scientific work and cannot answer a new interpretive question. Do not
recommission the same investigation merely to fix its representation.

RESOURCE_ESTIMATE_GUIDANCE.literal:
resource_tool_estimates, when supplied, describe expected execution time and
configured resources for the declared execution classes. Use these expectations
with your own yield estimate and prior outcomes to choose useful work. A timing
experiment earns monitoring credit for timing information learned and updates
execution expectations. Missing history means duration is unknown. Job elapsed
time and the duration of an own monitoring action are distinct measurements.

WAIT_GUIDANCE.literal: A pending_child_ handle names your original in-process child, not an external event-provider target. To give its existing scheduler time to collect owned work, select wait with that handle, event returned, after_cursor 0 and reconsider_at null. An earlier ready owned sibling may wake this wait first; its original return is then collected before another decision. Waiting only reports readiness and earns no scientific credit. In-process state_changed/progress_committed events and mixed external wait conditions are not supported by this collection channel.

passes its raw signed difference to the estimator. Its only numerical stop rule
is available upper bound <= configured cost. It has no memory, smoothing,
consecutive-zero rule, action cap, source-completion test, or scientific gate.
